This big demon came to Gielinor in one of the early ages and is an ancient being with a great wealth of experience in battle.

Quest: Shadow of the Storm

Combat: Watch out! Agrith Naar will attack with melee and magic, switching depending upon your use of the protection prayers. Agrith Naar will also occasionally teleport you towards him, so attacking from a distance isn't always so easy. You must deal the finishing blow with Silverlight (provided in the arena).
